Tomato Chutney 
morning delights | chutney recipe | south indian flavours

Nutrition: 
C: 18 | F: 2 | P: 4
Calories: 91 per serve
Makes 4 portions

Ingredients
1 tsp oil
1 tsp urad dal
1 tsp mustard seed
4-5 garlic cloves 
2 onion, rough chop 
5-6 tomatoes, rough chop 
2 green chilli OR 2 dried red chilli ( if using dried red then add in after mustard seeds ) 
salt + red chilli powder + haldi
large handful of coriander, you can use stems too

Method 
add oil to the pan, then goes in urad dal and mustard seeds
follow that up with onions, garlic and chilli and cook on high till they get some colour ( i like to burn mine slightly as they impart an amazing flavour but upto you ) 
add in the tomatoes, spices and a little water and cook till your tomatoes get mushyyy 
once done, add in the coriander and combine
allow to cool and then blitz roughly, not too fine either but you do you :) 
serve it else store in the fridge for 2-3 days
